docs.summary: Divider component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use Divider to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing.
Divider works well for arranging related content and creating responsive layouts. Use it to maintain visual consistency throughout your application.

anatomy.description: Divider is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistent spacing
bestPractices.description: Use uniform gaps and padding with divider.

bestPractices.title: Don't vary spacing
bestPractices.description: Avoid inconsistent gaps that create visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Consider responsive behavior
bestPractices.description: Ensure divider adapts to different screen sizes.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore breakpoints
bestPractices.description: Fixed layouts can break on different devices.

bestPractices.title: Don't nest deeply
bestPractices.description: Avoid excessive nesting that complicates layout.

props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.
